mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test, or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS 3-month growth > 0.5% does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test, or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with negative 5-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test, or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as companies face reduced output and potential earnings declines.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -1% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test, or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test, or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of HOUST MoM > 5% and UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test, or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If a 3-month increase in PAYEMS by more than 200,000 does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test, or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals a supply-demand mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of INDPRO MoM < 0% and RSAFS MoM > 0.5% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05) in a walk-forward test, or if the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
